player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ JoJoJoin, a wɔde di wɔ 5x5 board a cells no wɔ nɔma 0-24.
Wɔ wo turn no, fa wo mark si empty cell biara, e.g. '[12]'.
WO DI nkunim wɔ bere a wo nya wo marks nnan wɔ nkan — nnan cells a ɛtoatoa wɔ horizontal, vertical, anaa diagonal.
Sɛ Player {player_id} no, wo ne '{symbol}'; wo opponent ne '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nsakrae a wɔde aba no nni ɔfã pɔtee bi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} nyɛ ɔdan a edi mu. Ɛwɔ sɛ ɛwɔ 0 ne 24 ntam.

game_action.placed: ɔkɔtɔni {player_id} de ne mark ({symbol}) wɔ sel {cell}.
